correctness.rationale: Three fully embedded exact integer minors: det(-1) at 3x3 order26, det(+1) at 3x4 order54, det(+2) at 4x4 order105; the verifier reconstructs all simplicial triangles and integer matrices and checks them. Two independent integral cocycles bound 3x3 rank; one integral cocycle bounds 3xn rank and persists nontrivially; the mod-two cross-row/column cocycle is nonzero on a fixed three-edge loop for all m,n>=4. Every later vertex has a connected link in the induced filtration based on a 4x4 or 3x4 rectangle, so the Mayer–Vietoris map on H1 is surjective. Two-skeleton base preservation and the global cocycles give the required lower bounds at all sizes. The proof states the witness constructions for every link and is not based on finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A natural uniform infinite family has nontrivial integral torsion which is absent at the sharp 3-row boundary; it is stable under growth in both graph parameters despite changes in vertex count and dimension. This is a topological transition and integral invariant invisible to ordinary rational Betti ranks, with explicit finite certificates, a structurally motivated induction, and a clear role in comparing open-neighborhood and higher-Hamming topology. The result is not a narrow arbitrary sample or a routine special case of the 4x4 computation.
